title: Spec ID
description: Spec ID, globally unique. Only lowercase English letters and hyphens. The name should convey the spec's contents so it can be understood without opening the spec. Referenced by tracing `@spec impl|test|contract <spec-id>[#<ac-id>]` to ensure coverage and for lookup purposes, e.g. `@spec impl place-pizza-order#auth-required` or `@spec test place-pizza-order#auth-required`
